name: rjknicks
caption:
NEW YORK GAVE UP 🎮🏀 The Knicks drafted RJ Barrett #3 and paid him $120M. Then the Knicks traded him to us.

• 2019 draft: New York takes him #3
• Sept 2022: Knicks extension, 4 years, $120M. Dec 30, 2023: traded to us
• Best Knicks season (2021-22): 20.0 PPG on 40.8% shooting
• 2024-25 with us: 21.1 PPG, 5.4 APG
• First 9 games this season: 21.6 PPG on 47.4%

Did the Knicks give up on him too early? 👇

beats.head: PICK 3
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: New York drafted RJ Barrett third overall and gave him a hundred and twenty million dollar extension. Sixteen months later, the Knicks traded him to us.
beats.dlg: NY: PICK 3, THEN $120M.|DEC 2023: TRADED TO US.

beats.head: BEST KNICKS YEAR
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: His best year in New York: twenty points a night, but on forty point eight percent shooting.

beats.head: WITH US
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: Two seasons ago with us: twenty-one point one points and five point four assists. More than he ever gave New York.

beats.head: FIRST 9 GAMES
beats.name: RJ
beats.vo: And through nine games this season: twenty-one point six points, on forty-seven percent shooting.

beats.head: TOO EARLY?
beats.vo: Did the Knicks give up on him too early? Comment below.
beats.dlg: DID NEW YORK GIVE UP|ON RJ TOO EARLY?

facts.claim: June 20, 2019: Knicks draft Barrett #3 (third overall) in the 2019 NBA draft; September 1, 2022: re-signs with the Knicks on a 4-year, $120M deal; December 30, 2023: Knicks trade him to the Raptors
